hero.subtitle: No middlemen. No hidden fees. Thousands of cars from verified owners all over Germany.

how.label: How it works
how.title: Three simple steps
how.subtitle: Find a car, book it and drive. It's that simple.
how.step1Desc: Enter your city, dates and filters. We'll show available cars near you.
how.step2Desc: Send a request to the owner. Once confirmed, pay securely online — the owner is paid only after the trip.
how.step3Desc: Meet the owner, get the keys and hit the road.

features.label: Why us
features.title: Reliable and convenient
features.f1Desc: Every owner is verified through Stripe before they can earn.
features.f2Desc: Request in 2 minutes. Owners respond within an hour.
features.f3Desc: Berlin, Munich, Hamburg, Frankfurt and 8 more cities.
features.f4Desc: Card payment via Stripe; the deposit is only reserved and released automatically.

owners.label: For owners
owners.title: Your car is idle — it could be earning
owners.subtitle: Rent out your car when you're not using it. You set the price and choose the renters. We take a minimal commission.
owners.benefit1: You choose who to rent to
owners.benefit3: Payouts straight to your bank account via Stripe

cta.title: Ready to ride?
cta.subtitle: Thousands of cars are waiting. Find yours in 2 minutes.

footer.tagline: The fastest growing car rental platform in Europe. Find a car, book it and drive.

settings.title: Settings
settings.notifDesc: Choose which booking counters to track. When at least one is on, the navbar shows live counts and polls every 10 seconds.

banner.title: Finish setting up payouts
banner.body: Connect a payout method with Stripe so renters can book your cars and you can get paid.

gate.title: Set up payouts before listing a car
gate.body: You need a connected Stripe payout account before you can publish a car — renters' payments can only be released to an account that's ready to receive them.

return.title: Finishing setup…
return.successBody: You're all set — you can now list cars and get paid.
return.pendingBody: Stripe is still processing your details. This can take a few minutes — check back shortly.

refresh.title: Your setup link expired
refresh.body: Onboarding links only stay valid for a short time. Start a new one to continue.
